pages.text: Mom put a handful of green onions on the noodles she sold. They made the broth smell lovely.
Today, Bung served Ddori's noodles. Bung wanted Ddori to finish a whole bowl.
Bung thought Ddori would dislike green onions and put none on.
Ddori ignored that bowl and watched Bung's instead. Not noticing, Bung removed still more onions.
Bung even took broth out of Ddori's noodles. Ddori reached toward Bung's bowl instead.
Bung moved it far away. Ddori never touched the noodles. They grew stiff.
The customers finished and left. Only Ddori's bowl stayed untouched.
Mom sat beside Ddori. "Did you look at Ddori's eyes, instead of the bowl?"
Bung followed Ddori's gaze. It led to Bung's bowl, piled with green onions.
Bung piled green onions on fresh noodles for Ddori. Slurp, slurp—all gone!
